question: Who has been appointed as the Deputy Executive Director of United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women (UN-Women) in June 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anita Bhatia**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres announced on 30 May 2019 the appointment of Anita Bhatia of India as Deputy Executive Director of the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women (UN Women).
 
• She was also appointed as the Assistant Secretary-General for Resource Management, Sustainability and Partnerships.
 
• She served for several years as Director of Global Partnerships for the International Finance Corporation (IFC), the World Bank Group’s private sector arm. 
 
• Ms. Bhatia holds a Bachelor of Arts in History from Calcutta University, a Master of Arts in Political Science from Yale University and a Juris Doctor in Law from Georgetown University.
